text.body: pātrāṇi puruṣapātrāṇi dhṛtarāṣṭraḥ - kauravāṇāṃ pitā| bhaṭaḥ - jayatrāto vārtāharaḥ| duryodhanaḥ - kururājaḥ| duḥśāsanaḥ - kururājasya yavīyān bhrātā śakuniḥ - kururājasya mātulaḥ| ghaṭotkacaḥ - dautyenāgato bhīmaputro rākṣasaḥ| strīpātrāṇi gāndhārī - kauravāṇāṃ mātā| duḥśalā - kauravāṇāṃ svasā jayadrathapatnī| pratīhārī - dvārapālikā| nāṭakam (nāndyante tataḥ praviśati sūtradhāraḥ|) sūtradhāraḥ- nārāyaṇastribhuvanaikaparāyaṇo vaḥ pāyādupāyaśatayuktikaraḥ surāṇām| lokatrayāviratanāṭakatantravastuprastāvanapratisamāpanasūtradhāraḥ || 1 || (parikramya) evamāryamiśrānvijñāpayaāmi| aye kiṃ nu khalu mayi vijñāpanavyagre śabda iva śrūyate| aṅga paśyāmi| (nepathye) bho bho nivedyatāṃ nivedyatāṃ tāvat| sūtradhāraḥ- bhavatu vijñātam| eṣa khalu saṃśaptakānīkanivāhite janārdanasahāye dhanañjaye tadanantaramupagatabhīṣmavadhāmarṣitairdhārtarāṣṭraiḥ parivārya nipātitaḥ kumāro'bhimanyuḥ| tathāhi yāntyarjunapratyabhiyānabhītā yato'rjunastāṃ diśamīkṣamāṇāḥ| narādhipāḥ svāni niveśanāni saubhadrabāṇāṅkitanaṣṭasaṃjñāḥ || 2 || (tataḥ praviśati bhaṭaḥ |) bhaṭaḥ- bho bhoḥ! nivedyatāṃ tāvatputraśataślāghyabāndhavāya vijñānavistāritavinayācāradīrghacakṣuṣe mahārājāya dhṛtarāṣṭrāya| eṣa khalu yodhasyandanavājivāraṇavadhairvikṣobhya rājñāṃ balaṃ bālenārjunakarma yena samare līlāyatā darśitam| saubhadraḥ sa raṇe narādhipaśatairvegāgataiḥ sarvaśaḥ khe śakrasya pitāmahasya sahasaivotsaṅgamāropitaḥ || 3 || (tataḥ praviśati dhṛtarāṣṭro gāndhārī duḥśalā pratihārī ca|) dhṛtarāṣṭraḥ- kathaṃ nu bhoḥ! kenaitacchratipathadūṣaṇaṃ kṛtaṃ me ko'yaṃ me priyamiti vipriyaṃ bravīti| ko'smākaṃ śiśuvadhapātakāṅkitānāṃ vaṃśasya kṣayamavaghoṣayatyabhītaḥ || 4 || gāndhārī- mahārāa! atthi uṇa jāṇīadi kevalaṃ puttasaṃkhaakārao kulaviggaho bhavissidi tti| (mahārāja! asti punajrñāyate kevalaṃ putrasaṃkṣayakārakaḥ kulavigraho bhaviṣyatīti|) dhṛtarāṣṭraḥ- gāndhāri! jñāyate| gāndhārī- mahārāa kadā ṇu khu | (mahārāja kadā nu khalu|) dhṛtarāṣṭraḥ- gāndhāri! śrṛṇu adyābhimanyunidhanājjanitaprakopaḥ sāmarṣakṛṣṇadhṛtaraśmiguṇapratodaḥ| pārthaḥ kariṣyati tadugradhanuḥsahāyaḥ śāÏnta gamiṣyati vināśamavāpya lokaḥ || 5 || gāndhārī- hāvaccha abhimañño! īdise vi ṇāma purusakhaakārae kulaviggahe vattamāṇe vālabhāvaṇibhajjaṇaṃ amhāṇaṃ bhaggākameṇa karaaṃto kahiṃ dāṇiṃ pottaa! gadosi| (hā vatsa abhimanyo! īdṛśe'pi nāma puruṣakṣayakārake kulavigrahe vartamāne bālabhāvanimajjanamasmākaṃ bhāgyakrameṇa kurvan kutredānīṃ pautraka! gato'si|) duḥśalā- jeṇa dāṇi uttarāe vedhavvaṃ dāidaṃ, teṇa attaṇo juvadijaṇassa vedhavvamādiṭṭhaṃ| (yenedānīṃ vadhvai uttarāyai vaidhavyaṃ dattaṃ tenātmano yuvatijanāya vaidhavyamādiṣṭam|) dhṛtarāṣṭraḥ- atha kenaiṣa vyasanārṇavasya setubandhaḥ kṛtaḥ | bhaṭaḥ- mahārāja! mayā| dhṛtarāṣṭraḥ- ko bhavān| bhaṭaḥ- mahārāja! nanu jayatrāto'smi| dhṛtarāṣṭraḥ- jayatrāta! kenābhimanyurnihataḥ kasya jīvitamapriyam| pañcānāṃ pāṇḍavāgnīnāṃ ātmā kenendhanīkṛtaḥ || 6 || bhaṭaḥ- mahārāja! bahubhiḥ kila pārthivaiḥ samāgatairnihataḥ kumāro'bhimanyuḥ| syāttu jayadratho nimittabhūtaḥ| dhṛtarāṣṭraḥ- hanta jayadratho nimittabhūtaḥ| bhaṭaḥ- mahārāja atha kim| dhṛtarāṣṭraḥ- hanta jayadratho nihataḥ| (tacchutvā duḥśalā roditi|) dhṛtarāṣṭraḥ- kaiṣā roditi| pratīhārī- mahārāa! bhaṭṭidāriā duśśalā| (mahārāja! bhartṛdārikā duḥśalā|) dhṛtarāṣṭraḥ- vatse alamalaṃ ruditena| paśya, bhartuste nūnamatyantamavaidhavyaṃ na rocate| yena gāṇḍīvibāṇānāmātmā lakṣīkṛtaḥ svayam || 7 || duḥśalā- teṇa hi aṇujāṇādu maṃ tādo, ahaṃ vi gamissaṃ vahūe uttarāe saāsaṃ| (tena hyanujānātu māṃ tātaḥ ahamapi gamiṣyāmi vadhvā uttarāyāḥ sakāśam|) dhṛtarāṣṭraḥ- vatse kimabhidhāsyasi| duḥśalā- tāda! evaṃ ca bhaṇissaṃ - ajjakāliaṃ ca de vesaggahaṇaṃ ahaṃ vi avadhāraissāmi tti| (tāta! evaṃ ca bhaṇiṣyāmi - adyakālikaṃ ca te veṣagrahaṇamahamapyupadhārayiṣyāmīti|) gāndhārī- puttie! mā khu mā khu amaṃgalaṃ bhaṇāhi| jīvadi khu de bhattā| (putrike ! mā khalu, mā khalvamaṅgalaṃ bhaṇa| jīvati khalu te bhartā|) duḥśalā- amba! kudo me ettiāṇi bhāadheāṇi| jo jaṇaddaṇasahāassa dhaṇaṃjaassa viṇpiaṃ karia kohi ṇāma jīvissidi| (amba! kuto me etāvanti bhāgadheyāni| yo janārdanasahāyasya dhanañjayasya vipriyaṃ kṛtvā ko hi nāma jīviṣyati|) dhṛtarāṣṭraḥ- satyamāha tapasvinī duśśalā| kutaḥ, kṛṣṇasyāṣṭabhujopadhānaracite yo'ṅke vivṛddhaściraṃ yo mattasya halāyudhasya bhavati prītyā dvitīyo madaḥ| pārthānāṃ suratulyavikramavatāṃ snehasya yo bhājanaṃ taṃ hatvā ka ihopalapsyati ciraṃ svairduṣkṛtairjīvitam || 8 || jayamātra! atha tadavasthaṃ putraṃ dṛṣṭvā kiṃ pratipannaṃ tena gāṇḍīvadhanvanā| bhaṭaḥ- mahārāja! kiṃ vārjunasamīpe vṛttametat| dhṛtarāṣṭraḥ- kathamarjuno'pi nātrāsīt| bhaṭaḥ- mahārāja! atha kim| dhṛtarāṣṭraḥ- kathamidānīṃ vṛttametat| bhaṭaḥ- śrūyatāṃ - saṃśaptakānīkanivāhite janārdanasahāye dhanañjaye dhanañjaye sa bāla bhāvādadṛṣṭadoṣaḥ saṅgramamavatīrṇaḥ kumāro'bhimanyuḥ| dhṛtarāṣṭraḥ- hanta yuktarūpo'sya vadhaḥ| kohi saṃnihitaśārdūlāṃ guhāṃ dharṣayituṃ śaktaḥ| atha śeṣāḥ pāṇḍavāḥ kimanutiṣṭhanti| bhaṭaḥ- mahārāja! śrūyatām| citāṃ na tāvatsvayamasya dehamāropayantyarjunadarśanārtham| teṣāṃ ca nāmānyupadhārayanti yaistasya gātre prahṛtaṃ narendraiḥ || 9 || dhṛtarāṣṭraḥ- gāndhāri! tadāgamyatām| gaṅgākūlameva yāsyāvaḥ| gāndhārī- mahārāa! ṇaṃ tahiṃ gāhāmo| (mahārāja! nanu tatra gāhāvahe|) dhṛtarāṣṭraḥ- gāndhāri! śrṛṇu| adyaiva dāsyāmi jalaṃ hatebhyaḥ svenāparādhena tavātmajebhyaḥ| na tvasmi śaktaḥ salilapradānaiḥ kartuṃ nṛpāṇāṃ śibiroparodham || 10 || (tataḥ praviśati duryodhano duśśāsanaḥ śakuniśca|) duryodhanaḥ- vatsa duśśāsana! yāto'bhimanyunidhanāt sthiratāṃ virodhaḥ prāpto jayaḥ pracalitā ripavo nirastāḥ| unmūlito'sya ca mado madhūsūdanasya labdho mayā'dya samamabhyudayena śabdaḥ || duśśāsanaḥ- aho tu khalu, ruddhāḥ pāṇḍusutā jayadrathabalenākramya śatrorbalaṃ saubhadre vinipātite śaraśatakṣepairdvitīye'rjune| prāptaiśca vyasanāni bhīṣmapatanādasmābhiradyāhave tīvrāḥ śokaśarāḥ kṛtāḥ khalu manasyeṣāṃ sutotsādanāt || 12 || śakuniḥ- jayadrathenādya mahatkṛtaṃ raṇe nṛpairasambhāvitamātmapauruṣam| prasahya teṣāṃ yadanena saṃyuge samaṃ sutenāpratimaṃ hṛtaṃ yaśaḥ || 13 || duryodhanaḥ- mātula! itastāvat| duśśāsana! itastāvat| tatrabhavantaṃ tātamabhivādayiṣyāmaḥ| śakuniḥ- vatsa duryodhana! mā maivam| kāmaṃ na tasya rucitaḥ kulavigraho'yamasmāṃśca garhayati sa priyapāṇḍavatvāt| yuddhotthitairjayamavāpya hi tulyarūpaṃ evaṃ prahṛṣṭavadanairabhigantumenam || 14 || duryodhanaḥ- mātula! mā maivam| yathā tathā bhavatu| tatrabhavantaṃ tātamabhivādayiṣyāmaḥ| ubhau- bāḍham| (parikrāmati|) duryodhanaḥ- tāta! duryodhano'hamabhivādaye| duśśāsanaḥ- tāta! duśśāsano'hamabhivādaye| śakuniḥ- śakunirahamabhivādaye| sarve- kathamāśīrvacanaṃ na prayujyate| dhṛtarāṣṭraḥ- putra! kathamāśīrvacanamiti| saubhadre nihate bāle hṛdaye kṛṣṇapārthayoḥḥ| jīvite nirapekṣāṇāṃ kathamāśīḥ prayujyate || 15 || duryodhanaḥ- tāta! kiṃkṛto'yaṃ sambhramaḥ! dhṛtarāṣṭraḥ- kiṃkṛto'yaṃ sambhrama iti| ekā kule'sminbahuputranāthe labdhā sutā putraśatādviśiṣṭā| sā bāndhavānāṃ bhavatāṃ prasādād vaidhavyamaślāghyamavāpsyatīti || 16 || duryodhanaḥ- tāta! kiṃ cātra jayadrathasya| dhṛtarāṣṭraḥ- tena kila varavidagdhena ruddhāḥ pāṇḍavāḥ| duryodhanaḥ- āḥ tena ruddhāḥ| bahubhiḥ khalvanyaiḥ| dhṛtarāṣṭraḥ- bhoḥ! kaṣṭam| bahūnāṃ samavetānāmekasminnirghṛṇātmanām| bāle putre praharatāṃ kathaṃ na patitā bhujāḥ || 17 || duryodhanaḥ- tāta! vṛddhaṃ bhīṣmaṃ chalairhatvā teṣāṃ na patitā bhujāḥ| hatvāsmākaṃ patiṣyanti tamabālaparākramam || 18 || dhṛtarāṣṭraḥ- vatsa! kiṃ bhīṣmasya nipātanamabhimanyośca vadhaḥ samaḥ| duryodhanaḥ- tāta! kathaṃ na samaḥ| dhṛtarāṣṭraḥ- putra! śrūyatām, svacchandamṛtyurnihato hi bhīṣmaḥ svenopadeśena kṛtātmatuṣṭiḥ| ayaṃ tu bālaḥ kuruvaṃśanāthaśchinno'rjunasya prathamaḥ pravālaḥ || 11 || duśśāsanaḥ- tāta! bālo na bāla iti| abhimanyunā, dhṛtarāṣṭraḥ- kiṃ kiṃ duśśāsano vyāharati| duśśāsanaḥ- atha kim| sarveṣāṃ naḥ paśyatāṃ yudhyatāṃ ca vyāyāmoṣṇaṃ gṛhya cāpaṃ kareṇa| sūryeṇaivābhyāgatairaṃśujālaiḥ sarve bāṇairaṅkitā bhūmipālāḥ || 20 || dhṛtarāṣṭraḥ- kaṣṭaṃ bhoḥ! bālenaikena tāvadbhoḥ! saubhadreṇedṛśaṃ kṛtam| putravyasanasantaptaḥ pārtho vaḥ kiṃ kariṣyati || 21 || duryodhanaḥ- kiṃ kariṣyati| dhṛtarāṣṭraḥ- tatkariṣyati, yatsāvaśeṣāyuṣo drakṣyatha| duryodhanaḥ- tāta! kastāvadarjuno nāma| dhṛtarāṣṭraḥ- putra! arjunamapi na jānīṣe| duryodhanaḥ- tāta! na jāne| dhṛtarāṣṭraḥ- tena hi ahamapi na jāne| kintu arjunasya balavīryajñāḥ bahavaḥ santi| tān pṛccha| duryodhanaḥ- tāta! ke'rjunasya balavīryajñā mayā praṣṭavyāḥ| dhṛtarāṣṭraḥ- putra! śrūyatām| śakraṃ pṛccha purā nivātakavacaprāṇopahārārcitaṃ pṛcchāstraiḥ paritoṣitaṃ bahuvidhaiḥ kairātarūpaṃ haram| pṛcchāÏgna bhujagāhutipraṇayinaṃ yastarpitaḥ khāṇḍave vidyārakṣitamadya yena ca jitastvaṃ pṛccha citrāṅgadam || 22 || duryodhanaḥ- yadyetadvīryamarjunasya kimasmākaṃ bale na santi pratiyoddhāro'rjunasya| dhṛtarāṣṭraḥ- putra! ke te| duryodhanaḥ- nanu karṇa eva tāvat| dhṛtarāṣṭraḥ- aho hāsyaḥ khalu tapasvī karṇaḥ| duryodhanaḥ- kena kāraṇena? dhṛtarāṣṭraḥ- śrūyatāṃ, śakrāpanītakavaco'rdharathaḥ pramādī vyājopalabdhaviphalāstrabalo ghṛṇāvān| karṇo'rjunasya kila yāsyati tulyabhāvaṃ yadyastradānaguravo dahanendrarudrāḥ || 23 || śakuniḥ- prabhavati bhavānasmānadhīrayituṃ| dhṛtarāṣṭraḥ- śakunireṣa vyāharati| bhoḥ śakune! tvayā hi yatkṛtaṃ karma satataṃ dyūtaśalinā| tatkulasyāsya vairāgnirbāleṣvapi na śāmyati || 24 || duryodhanaḥ- aye, bhūmikampaḥ saśabdo'yaṃ kuto nu sahasoetthitaḥ| ulkābhiśca patantībhiḥ prajvālitamivāmbaram || 25 || dhṛtarāṣṭraḥ- putra! evaṃ manye, suvyaktaṃ nihataṃ dṛṣṭvā pautramāyastacetasaḥ| ulkārūpāḥ patantyete mahendrasyāśrubindavaḥ || 26 || duryodhanaḥ- jayatrāta! gaccha, pāṇḍavaśibire śaṅkhapaṭahasiṃhanādaravonmiśraḥ kiṃkṛto'yaṃ śabda iti jñāyatām| bhaṭaḥ- yadājñāpayati| (niṣkramya praviśya) jayatu mahārājaḥ| saṃśaptakānīkanivāhiṃtapratinivṛtena dhanañjayena nihataṃ putramaṅkasthamaśrubhiḥ pariṣicya janārdanāvabhaÐtsatena pratijñātaṃ kilānena| duryodhanaḥ- kimiti kimiti| bhaṭaḥ- tasyaiva vyavasāyatuṣṭahṛdayaistadvikramotsāhibhistuṣṭāsyairjitamityavekṣya sahasā nādaḥ praharṣātkṛtaḥ| ākrāntā gurubhirdharādharavaraiḥ saṃkṣobhitaiḥ pārthivairbhūmiścāgatasambhrameva yuvatistasmin kṣaṇe kampitā || 27 || dhṛtarāṣṭraḥ- pratijñāsāramātreṇa kampiteyaṃ vasundharā| suvyaktaṃ dhanuṣi spṛṣṭe trailokyaṃ vicaliṣyati || 28 || duryodhanaḥ- jayatrāta! kimanena pratijñātam| bhaṭaḥ- yena me nihataḥ putrastuÏṣṭa ye ca hate gatāḥ| śvaḥ sūrye'stamasamprāpte nihaniṣyāmi tānaham || 29 || duryodhanaḥ- pratijñāvyāghāte kiṃ prāyaścittam| bhaṭaḥ- citārohaṇaṃ kila gāṇḍīvena saha| duryodhanaḥ- mātula! citārohaṇaṃ citārohaṇam| vatsa duśśāsana! citārohaṇaṃ citārohaṇam| vayamapi tāvatpratijñāvyāghāte prayatnamanutiṣṭhāmaḥ| dhṛtarāṣṭraḥ- putra! kiṃ kariṣyasi| duryodhanaḥ- nanu sarvākṣauhiṇīsandohena cchādayiṣye jayadrathaṃ| api ca, droṇopadeśena yathā tathāhaṃ saṃyojaye vyūhamabhedyarūpam | khinnāśayāste sagajāḥ sayodhā aprāptakāmā jvalanaṃ viśeyuḥ || 30 || dhṛtarāṣṭraḥ- api praviṣṭaṃ dharaṇīmapyārūḍhaṃ nabhasthalam| sarvatrānugamiṣyanti śarāste kṛṣṇacakṣuṣaḥ || 31 || bhaṭaḥ- krūramevaṃ narapatiṃ nityamudyataśāsanam| yaḥ kaścidaparo brūyānna tu jīvetsa tatkṣaṇam || 32 || (tataḥ praviśati ghaṭotkacaḥ|) ghaṭotkacaḥ- eṣa bhoḥ! prayāmi saubhadravināśacoditaḥ didṛkṣuradyārimanāryacetasam| vicintayaṃścakradharasya śāsanaṃ yathā gajendro'ṅkaśaśaṅkito balim || 33 || (adho vilokya) idamasyopasthānagṛhadvāram| yāvadavatarāmi| (avatīrya) ātmanaivātmānaṃ nivedayiṣye| bhoḥ! haiḍimbo'smi ghaṭotkaco yadupatervākyaṃ gṛhītvāgato draṣṭavyo'tra mayā guruḥ svacaritairdoṣairgataḥ śatrutām| duryodhanaḥ- ehyehi praviśasva śatrubhavanaṃ kautūhalaṃ me mahat dhṛṣṭaṃ śrāvaya māṃ janārdanavaco duryodhano'haṃ sthitaḥ || 34 || ghaṭotkacaḥ- (praviśya) aye ayamatrabhavān dhṛtarāṣṭraḥ| anāryaśatasyotpādayitā| ayaṃ nanu lalitagambhīrākṛtiviśeṣaḥ| āścaryamāścaryam| bṛddho'pyanātatavalī gurusaṃhatāṃsaḥ śraddheyarūpa iva putraśatasya dhṛtyā| manye suraistridivarakṣaṇajātaśaṅkaistrāsānnimīlitamukho'trabhavān hi sṛṣṭaḥ || 35 || (upasṛtya) pitāmaha! abhivādaye ghaṭotka (ityardhokte) na na ayamakramaḥ| yudhiṣṭhirādayaśca me guravo bhavantamabhivādayanti| paścāddhaṭotkaco'hamabhivādaye| dhṛtarāṣṭraḥ- ehyehi putra! na me priyaṃ duḥkhamidaṃ mamāpi yad bhrātṛnāśād vyathitastavātmā| itthaṃ ca te nānugato'yamartho matputradoṣātkṛpaṇīkṛto'smi || 36 || ghaṭotkacaḥ- aho kalyāṇaḥ khalvatrabhavān| kalyāṇānāṃ prasūtiṃ pitāmahamāha bhagavāṃścakrāyudhaḥ| dhṛtarāṣṭraḥ- (āsanādutthāya|) kimājñāpayati bhagavāṃścakrāyudhaḥ| ghaṭotkacaḥ- na na na| āsanasthenaiva bhavatā śrotavyo janārdanasya sandeśaḥ| dhṛtarāṣṭraḥ- yadājñāpayati bhagavāṃścakrāyudhaḥ| (upaviśati|) ghaṭotkacaḥ- pitāmaha! śrūyatām| hā vatsa abhimanyo! hā vatsa kurukulapradīpa! hā vatsa yadukulapravāla! tava jananīṃ mātulaṃ māmapi parityajya pitāmahaṃ draṣṭumāśayā svargamabhigato'si| pitāmaha! ekaputravināśādarjunasya tāvadīdṛśī khalvavasthā, kā punarbhavato bhaviṣyati| tataḥkṣipramidānīmātmabalādhānaṃ kuruṣva| yathā te putraśokasamutthito'gnirna dahetprāṇamayaṃ haviriti| dhṛtarāṣṭraḥ- sakrodhavyavasāyena kṛṣṇenaitadudāhṛtam| paśyāmīva hi gāṇḍīvī sarvakṣatravadhe dhṛtaḥ || 37 || sarve- aho hāsyamabhidhānam| ghaṭotkacaḥ- kimetaddhāsyate| duryodhanaḥ- etaddhāsyate| devairmantrayate sa kṛṣṇo jātamatsaraḥ| pārthenaikena yo vetti nihataṃ rājamaṇḍalam || 38 || ghaṭotkacaḥ- hasati tvamahaṃ vaktā preṣitaścakrapāṇinā| śrāvitaṃ pārthakarmedamaho yuktaṃ tavaiva tu || 39 || api ca bhavatāpi śrotavyo janārdanasya sandeśaḥ| duśśāsanaḥ- mā tāvat bhoḥ! kṣatriyāvamānin! pṛthivyāṃ śāsanaṃ yasya dhāryate sarvapārthivaiḥ| sandeśaḥ śroṣyate'pyanyo na rājñastasya sannidhau || 40 || ghaṭotkacaḥ- kathaṃ duśśāsano vyaharati| are duśśāsana! arājā nāma bhavatāṃ cakrāyudhaḥ haṃ bhoḥ! muktā yena jarā purānnṛpatayaḥ prabhraṣṭamānocchrayāḥ yenāghryaṃ nṛpamaṇḍalasya miṣato bhīṣmāgrahastāddhatam| śrīryasyābhiratā niyogasumukhī śrīvatsaśayyāgṛhe ślāghyaḥ pārthivapārthivastava kathaṃ rājā na cakrāyudhaḥ || 41 || duryodhanaḥ- duśśāsana! alaṃ vivādena| rājā vā yadi vā'rājā balīṃ vā yadi vā'balī| bahunātra kimuktena kimāha bhavatāṃ prabhuḥ || 42 || ghaṭotkacaḥ- atha kimatha kim| prabhureva trailokyanātho bhagavāṃścakrāyudhaḥ| viśeṣato'smākaṃ prabhuḥ| api ca, avasitamavagaccha kṣatriyāṇāṃ vināśaṃ nṛpaśatavinicityā lāghavaṃ cāstu bhūmeḥ| na hi tanayavināśādudyatogrāstramukteḥ samaraśirasi kaścitphalgunasyātibhāraḥ || 43 || śakuniḥ- yadi syādvākyamātreṇa nirjiteyaṃ vasundharā| vākye vākye yadi bhavetsarvakṣatravadhaḥ kṛtaḥ || 44 || ghaṭotkacaḥ- re! re! śakunireṣa vyāharati| bhoḥ śakune! akṣānvimuñca śakune! kurubāṇayogyamaṣṭāpadaṃ samarakarmaṇi yuktarūpam| na hātra dāraharaṇaṃ na ca rājyatantraṃ prāṇāḥ paṇo'tra ratirugrabalaiśca bāṇaiḥ || 45 || duryodhanaḥ- bho bhoḥ! prakṛtiṃ gataḥ| kṣipasi vadasi rūkṣaṃ laṃghayitvā pramāṇaṃ na ca gaṇayasi kiñcivdyāharandīrdhahastaḥ| yadi khalu tava darpo mātṛpakṣograrūpo vayamapi khalu raudrāḥ rākṣasograsvabhāvāḥ || 46 || ghaṭotkacaḥ- śāntaṃ śāntaṃ pāpam| rākṣasebhyo'pi bhavanta eva krūratarāḥ| kutaḥ, na tu jatugṛhe suptān bhrātṛn dahanti niśācarāḥ śirasi na tathā bhrātuḥ patnīṃ spṛśanti niśācarāḥ| na ca sutavadhaṃ saṃkhye kartuṃ smaranti niśācarāḥ vikṛtavapuṣo'pyugrācārā ghṛṇā na tu varjitā || 47 || duryodhanaḥ- dūtaḥ khalu bhavān prāpto na tvaṃ yuddhārthamāgataḥ| gṛhītvā gaccha sandeśaṃ na vayaṃ dūtaghātakāḥ || 48 || ghaṭotkacaḥ- (saroṣam) kiṃ dūta iti māṃ pradharṣayasi| mā tāvad bhoḥ! na dūto'ham | alaṃ vo vyavasāyena praharadhvaṃ samāhatāḥ| jyācchedāddurbalo nāhamabhimanyuriha sthitaḥ || 49 || mahāneṣa kaiśorako'yaṃ me manorathaḥ| api ca, daṣṭoṣṭho muṣṭimudyamya tiṣṭhatyeṣa ghaṭotkacaḥ| uttiṣṭhatu pumān kaścidgantumicchedyamālayam || 50 || (sarve uttiṣṭhanti|) dhṛtarāṣṭraḥ- pautra ghaṭotkaca! marṣayatu marṣayatu bhavān| madvacanāvagantā bhava| ghaṭotkacaḥ- bhavatu bhavatu| pitāmahasya vacanāhūto'hamasmi| tathāpi hi na śaknomi roṣaṃ dhārayitum| kimiti vijñāpyastatrabhavān nārāyaṇaḥ| duryodhanaḥ- ā kasya vijñāpyam| madvacanādevaṃ sa vaktavyaḥ, kiṃ vyarthaṃ bahu bhāṣase na khalu te pāruṣyasādhyā vayaṃ kopānnārhasi kiṃcideva vacanaṃ yuddhaṃ yadā dāsyasi| niryāmyeṣa nirantaraṃ nṛpaśatacchatrāvalībhirvṛtastiṣṭha tvaṃ saha pāṇḍavaiḥ prativaco dāsyāmi te sāyakaiḥ || 41 || ghaṭotkacaḥ- pitāmaha! eṣa gacchāmi| dhṛṣṭarāṣṭaḥ- pautra! gaccha, gaccha| ghaṭotkacaḥ- bho bho rājānaḥ! śrūyatāṃ janārdanasya paścimaḥ sandeśaḥ| dharmaṃ samācara kuru svajanavyapekṣāṃ yatkāṃkṣitaṃ manasi sarvamihānutiṣṭha| jātyopadeśa iva pāṇḍavarūpadhārī sūryāṃśubhiḥ samamupaiṣyati vaḥ kṛtāntaḥ || 52 || (niṣkrāntaḥ sarve|) dūtaghaṭotkacaṃ nāmotsṛṣṭikāṅkaṃ samāptam ||
